style: simple warm pixel poster, learned 5-tone procedural-teacher approximation
postprocess: repeat each final RGB pixel 8 times horizontally and 8 times vertically, nearest neighbor; NO style teacher, palette or extra color filter
rounding: nearest, ties toward +infinity; applies to negative acc before saturation
weight_order: OIHW C-order, signed two-complement int8; .bin one byte per weight
bias_order: output channel, signed little-endian int32; .hex one 32-bit word per line
activation_order: golden layers HWC; .bin RGB HWC and CHW variants explicitly named
padding: zero at FIRST LOW-RES conv only, NOT reflect; input zero=0
normalization: 2 training BatchNorm layers folded into conv weights and biases before QAT
onnx_note: fp32.onnx is standard floating model; integer_reference.onnx uses FP32-valued INTEGER arithmetic for a portable golden, not QLinearConv or an FPGA bitstream
hardware_compatibility: new graph and UINT8 activations; incompatible with prior C4 signed-INT8 residual/tanh graph, loader and BIT without accelerator integration
